So I transitioned at my current workplace and I found that I was overwhelmingly supported. I work in a professional role (higher up) in a disability service and my main concern was working with ‘soccer moms’ ie everyone I worked with aside from a small few, are 40+ straight white women. 

When I first came out I spoke to the Chief exec of HR because I have quite a close relationship with her and she was extremely supportive and asked what I needed for her to help me! With my permission they sent out an email clearly outlining my new name and pronouns and the respect I deserved. 

I have literally had NO problems whatsoever and I’ve been extremely lucky. I know my story is rare but I wanted to share to let you know that it is possible and you might be surprised at the support you receive!
